visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with an interior tour of a restaurant featuring rich wooden paneling, orange-lit shelving, and red cushioned booths against a gray mural background. (2) A close-up reveals a wooden tray holding multiple small dishes, centering on a bowl of rice topped with several large, cooked shrimp and green onions. (3) The scene shifts to a kitchen where a chef is cooking shrimp in a black pan; large flames erupt as garlic and green onions are tossed in. (4) Back at the table, black chopsticks lift a succulent shrimp, and a spoon scoops a hearty portion of rice drizzled with sauce and topped with shrimp. (5) A series of quick cuts highlights side dishes including a vibrant salad with corn, a cup of steamed egg with crab stick, a piece of tofu with brown sauce, and a pickled tomato on radish. (6) A second main dish is introduced: a beef steak bowl topped with a soft-boiled egg, sliced onions, and green onions; the egg is broken, allowing the golden yolk to coat the meat. (7) Dessert is showcased with a creamy caramel pudding and a slice of chocolate crepe cake, followed by a person pouring tea from a labeled glass bottle into a glass. (8) A basket of golden-brown fried snacks, including squid and onion rings, is presented with a side of white dipping sauce. (9) The final shots show the restaurant's logo featuring a black cat wearing a red hat and the name '究鶴' (TSIOK-HO) along with the address.
